## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: HiveRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

private readonly items = new Map<string, Hive>();
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A is the Hive entity itself, the thing HiveRepository stores (`private readonly items = new Map<string, Hive>();`). B is "Hive Status", which BeekeepingService defines. It looks like a computed status view built around a hive: it is keyed by `hive.id` and adds extra data such as `latestInspection: this.latestInspection(hive.id)`. It refers to a hive but is not the same business concept. It is a status or summary that joins hive data with inspection data. Sharing a hive id is not enough to call them the same concept.
